vacancies.title: Copernicus LSTM Lead Space Segment Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA space-segment leadership role with thermal-infrared mission context; Lead-level spacecraft project experience is a major seniority stretch.

vacancies.title: AOCS and Pointing Systems Engineer (3 Positions)
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA AOCS role with relevant control/mechatronics, sensors, actuators and verification overlap; dedicated spacecraft AOCS/GNC experience is the main stretch.

vacancies.title: Copernicus CRISTAL and Sentinel-3 Next Generation Topography Lead System Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC spacecraft system-engineering role; Lead-level spacecraft system-engineering experience is a major stretch.

vacancies.title: D2D 5G/6G Network Lead Mission Engineer

vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A5 project-management role for LSTM spacecraft implementation. Strong mission/hardware context, but 10 years relevant professional experience and people-management responsibility make this a major seniority stretch.

vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 role posted 22 September. Included for high recall, but telecom payload engineering is outside the strongest mechanical/hardware profile.

vacancies.title: Secure Connectivity 5G NTN End-to-End System and Validation Lead Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA validation role but highly specialized in 5G NTN.

vacancies.title: Thermal Analysis and Verification Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strongest direct ESA match; highly relevant thermal analysis and verification work. Main stretch is professional spacecraft thermal experience and ESATAN-TMS.

vacancies.title: Copernicus LSTM Satellite Engineering and AIV Manager
vacancies.assessment: Excellent technical and ESTEC exposure match across satellite engineering, AIV, integration and verification, but clearly a senior/stretch manager role requiring substantial spacecraft development and AIV leadership experience.

vacancies.title: Earth Observation Future Missions Optical Payload Engineer - Emerging Sensing Technologies
vacancies.assessment: Optical payload development, 5 years specialist experience required.

vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA ESTEC option; product development and project oversight match, satcom industry expertise stretch.

vacancies.title: PMSO Team Lead for Secure Connectivity

vacancies.title: Navigation Systems Evolution Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA ESTEC systems role. GNSS/PNT specialization is a substantial stretch.

vacancies.title: ESA Graduate Trainee in Remote Sensing Earth Observation Mission Concept Development
vacancies.assessment: Graduate traineeship in Earth observation mission analysis. Under-level and outside core mechanical engineering.

vacancies.title: EO Future Missions Optical Payload and Performance Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A2-A4 optical payload and early-phase mission engineering with hardware, technology breadboarding and industry technical management. Interesting optics and instrument exposure but a significant specialist stretch: requires at least five years of specific EO optical instrument development and optical mission/instrument performance modelling. Four-year fixed-term initial appointment.

vacancies.title: Photonic EEEE Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A2-A4 hardware and qualification role with laboratory tests, technology R&D, project reviews and industrial activity monitoring. Relevant to optics and engineering background, but highly specialised in photonic EEEE parts, lasers, fibre optics, CCD/CMOS/IR detectors and component reliability; MSc Mechanical Engineering and broad design experience are not a close substitute for four years of photonics/electronics expertise. Specialist stretch; 4-year contract extendable to indefinite.

vacancies.title: Lead End-to-End Performance Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 ESTEC role on SAGA QKD mission; interdisciplinary requirements, performance budgets, verification, industrial coordination and team leadership match general systems and technical project ambitions. Specialist space mission/optical QKD experience is a significant stretch. Minimum 4 years relevant professional experience; ESA may appoint at A1 when post-MSc experience is limited.

vacancies.title: CAT Project Manager
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 project leadership for autonomous capture/debris removal, highly relevant to long-term technical project management and robotics interests. Major seniority gap: explicitly requires >10 years hands-on spacecraft Phase B2/C/D/E and management of major industrial contracts, unlike general machine-building project experience. Strategic long-term radar, not a realistic immediate priority.

vacancies.title: Satcom Systems and Payload Lead
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 ESTEC role combining multidisciplinary technical leadership, industrial prime interfaces, payload qualification, verification, schedule/cost control. Strong leadership ambitions but requires specific advanced digital telecom payload and SatCom mission expertise, so a substantial specialist stretch. Minimum MSc plus 4 years relevant experience; A1 possible if post-MSc experience limited.

vacancies.title: SatCom AI Technology Lead
vacancies.location: ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands or ECSAT, Harwell, UK
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 position with ESTEC as an option and programme/product coordination, but core requirements are deep AI/ML and SatCom/5G NTN expertise. Outside principal mechanical/hardware engineering strengths, so low fit despite ESA employment and attractive grade. MSc plus four years relevant professional experience required.

vacancies.title: Propagation Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A2-A4 engineering role. Requires five years of specialist RF/optical propagation modelling and telecom/navigation channel characterisation; not closely aligned with mechanical design, mechanisms or thermal engineering.

vacancies.title: Product Assurance and Safety Engineer
vacancies.assessment: ESA LISA mission PA&S role. Requires 4 years of relevant experience. Strong career potential, stretch in space PA experience.

vacancies.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 NG Instrument Optical and Performance Lead Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC optical instrument role; requires 4 years relevant experience, significant optics specialization.

vacancies.title: Product Assurance and Safety Manager
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA ESTEC SAGA PA&S management role. Eight years directly relevant PA&S experience required; significant senior stretch despite mechanical engineering and PA training. Includes mechanical parts and manufacturing/test oversight.
